actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Blue-gray soft cap with red star and dark visor, cap-covered hair/brows, serious restrained closed mouth and near-front face retained. Blue-gray folded military collar and dark center fastening remain; fine upper-lip source shading is not converted to an invented heavy moustache, beard or glasses. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.

finite_alpha_support.boundary: Finite numeric support only; actual full image/source/white/cyan comparison supplies visual approval. Exterior alpha zero is expected. No global threshold acceptance.
